static_traits.name: Gao Rui
static_traits.social_status: 与同事关系因自我not足感而紧张；有几位亲密朋友，但谈及Self-doubt会感到not适而回避
static_traits.medical_history: without明显躯体疾病史；not yet接受过心理治疗；类似Self-doubt问题始于约一年前
static_traits.language_features: 逻辑清晰，表达流畅，合作度高；能具体描述情绪与躯体反应（如“胃部打结、惊慌”）；能进行自我Reflection

basic_info.main_problem: 尽管五年级Student很喜欢我，但仍觉得有其他老师比我更好，这导致Self-doubt和自卑感。
basic_info.core_demands: 这些Self-doubt的感受影响了我在课堂上的自信并造成日常生活压力，因此决定寻求咨询。

core_beliefs: I am not as good as others

special_situations.event: 教职工会议上同事因创新项目被公开表扬
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我have not被认可或have not拿出很有创意的成果，就说明我not够有能力
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 加倍与他人比较、自我苛责并追求完美以弥补“not足”
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我从not那么有创意，我not如她/他。

special_situations.event: 收到工作反馈（尤其非全为正面时）
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果反馈not是完全正面，就证明I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 反复回想负面部分并忽视正面评价，降低对自身长处的权重

special_situations.event: 与被同事认可或表现出色的同事互动/观察他人表现
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人做得更好，就意味着我失败、我比他们差
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 减少与同事深入互动以避免比较，私下反刍比较结果
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们就是天生比我强，我not配被认可。

special_situations.event: 自我评估课堂与教学表现时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有做到最好/完美才算称职，否则就是失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 设定过高标准、过度自我批评以驱动自我改进
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 如果not是最好的，那就等于失败。

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被看见与被认可，确认自己作为Teacher的价值与能力
core_conflict.fear: 害怕在比较中被negate、被贬低，体验羞耻与失败
defense_goal: 通过追求完美与自我苛责来避免被批评或negate
与同事保持一定距离以减少暴露短板的风险

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的、需要not断证明自己的老师
object_relations.object_representation: 更优秀、会评判自己的同事/权威

object_relations.self_representation: 被Student喜欢但仍担心“配not上”认可的老师
object_relations.object_representation: 掌握评价标准的学校/同侪群体

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师邀请其寻找反证、强调其成就与优势时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tends to talk about facts in an objectified, abstract manner, downplaying emotional experience and the subjective feeling of self-worth
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Steady tone, focusing on facts and logic, few emotional words; responds with generalized statements, avoiding deeply touching feelings of inferiority/shame

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当谈及同事获赞与对比场景时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将他人成功等同于对自我价值的negate
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以without奈且自贬的口吻强调“他们天赋/资源更好”，回避探索自身感受与多元评价标准

manifestations: 将自我价值过度绑定于外部认可与比较结果
他人被表扬时体验到自身努力“显得not够好”
即使周末在湖边放松仍被Self-doubt的思绪侵扰
outcomes: Tense relationships with colleagues、情绪Anxiety与羞耻

contact_model.definition: The individual has poor self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: 频繁以“I am not good enough”自我评判，降低对正向反馈的权重
在与同事互动与自我评估时过度谨慎，害怕显露短板

contact_model.definition: The individual turns the energy originally meant to be directed outward onto themselves, turning the force that could have been expressed outwardly/used to seek help into self-restraint and self-blame.
manifestations: not愿与朋友谈Self-doubt，将压力内化为自我苛责
周末独自消化Anxiety与紧张而非寻求支持

positive_force: Student与家长对其课堂的积极反馈与喜爱
具备自我Reflection能力并愿意主动求助（寻求咨询）
拥有几位可联络的亲密朋友作为潜在支持
negative_force: 完美主义与过度社会比较的思维习惯
倾向忽视正面证据、放大负面线索
对外部认可的高度依赖导致自信脆弱
与同事关系因自卑而紧张，进而减少支持与资源

target_behavior.behavior: 反复社会比较引发的Self-doubt与Anxiety
antecedent: 看到同事被表扬或展示成果
与同事互动交流工作进展
收到教学反馈（尤其非全为正面时）
周末Being alone试图放松时出现的侵入性比较思维
target_behavior.core_reason: 完美主义倾向与将自我价值绑定于外部比较与认可
target_behavior.function: Avoids failure and shame (through avoiding colleague interaction and self-reproach, as 'self-protection'), and tries to obtain external validation through higher standards
target_behavior.consequence: 课堂Decreased confidence、教学表现受影响；Tense relationships with colleagues；周末休闲被持续性压力与反刍打断；出现胃部紧绷与惊慌等身心反应
